svg.aria-label: The cat channel through two layers' softmaxes, each map divided by its sum, then mixed three quarters and one quarter into one pooled map. On the fused patch cat takes 0.982 in its own prompt and 0.4977 in a joint prompt.
svg.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.text: How the cat's latent becomes its pooled map
Each patch splits one unit between "cat" and the background token, whose key is 0.
on the fused top-left patch, "cat" takes 0.9820 of layer 1 in its own prompt,
and 0.4955 when "dog" competes for the same patch in one joint prompt.
